csv_project_name: AE for ICRC Crooked Creek Park Recreation Center Renov
csv_scope_of_work: The Irmo Chapin Recreation Commission (ICRC) is seeking proposals from qualified architectural firms to prepare a conceptual renovation plan for the recreation center located at Crooked Creek Park.The scope of services under this Request for Proposal includes the preparation of a conceptual renovation plan and related materials. The primary focus of this plan is to develop a conceptual renovation design that addresses the following items: Key Renovations Recreation Center o Add two new full-sized basketball courts (preferably one gymnasium divided into two full-sized basketball courts) o Expand the fitness area o Enlarge and square off existing corner rooms o Convert two small rooms into office spaces o Kitchen renovation o Increase and improve access to storage space o Add six new multipurpose rooms o Reconfigure or relocate the front desk and expand the lobby o Improve access, lighting, and circulation in high-use areas o Renovating, repairing, and/or replacing all current floors (excluding current basketball floor), walls, ceilings, built-ins, counters, and fixtures o Repurpose the racquetball court footprint into usable program space o Update all entrances and door systems o Modernize HVAC systems throughout the facility
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering

relevance_explanation:

- Current procurement is mainly for architectural conceptual planning, not explicit structural engineering.
